notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes: [p]We’d like to share some fresh news about the development of [b]Isolation One[/b]. The work is moving forward steadily, and a lot has been accomplished over the past months.[/p][p]⚙️ Key achievements:[/p][list][*][p]The project has been successfully migrated to [b]Unity 6[/b], giving us more possibilities to expand and refine the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented [b]URP (Universal Render Pipeline)[/b] – visuals are now more modern and polished, with improved performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]📅 However, there’s also an important announcement: the release of the game has been postponed to [b]2026[/b]. We know many of you were hoping to play sooner, but this extra time will allow us to bring Isolation One to the level of quality it truly deserves.[/p][p]Thank you so much for staying with us and supporting the project ❤️. More updates are coming soon – including new materials, screenshots, and dev diaries – so stay tuned![/p]
